theorem.statement: If one Shannon residual branch has a polynomially verifiable witness-dominance certificate into the other, the dominated branch and the split variable can be deleted exactly. SAT is preserved and every witness of the kept branch lifts by restoring the kept branch value.
theorem.potential: Lexicographic (# live Boolean variables, total literal occurrences) strictly decreases on every successful contraction.
theorem.ceiling: PARTIAL CONTRACTION OPERATOR ONLY; NO UNIVERSAL EXISTENCE THEOREM.

authority.input_contract: The witness-dominance certificate is part of the typed input and is polynomially verifiable.
authority.ceiling: NO CLAIM THAT EVERY 3CNF OR RIGID TORSO ADMITS SUCH A CERTIFICATE.

keymaster_barrier.scope: THE SIGNED-LITERAL-PERMUTATION/SUBSUMPTION CERTIFICATE FAMILY ONLY. AN EXPLICIT 3CNF STAR HAS TWO RESIDUAL BRANCH RELATIONS OF EQUAL SIZE WITH DIFFERENT HAMMING DISTANCE, SO NEITHER SIGNED-PERMUTATION DOMINATES THE OTHER. RICHER OR GROUPED WITNESS-DOMINANCE CERTIFICATES REMAIN OPEN.

open_bridge.requirement: Find a nonempty block whose residual branches all witness-dominate one representative, or normalize directly to an existing polynomial terminal class, with no exponential branch enumeration.
